{
  "name": "slopsquat-guard",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Stops Claude from installing hallucinated or typosquatted packages: every npm, pip, uv, poetry, cargo and gem install is checked against its registry first. Packages that don't exist are blocked; brand-new, barely used or lookalike packages ask you first.",
  "author": {
    "name": "awesome-claude-mods",
    "url": "https://github.com/Singh-AP/awesome-claude-mods"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Singh-AP/awesome-claude-mods/tree/main/mods/safety/slopsquat-guard",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Singh-AP/awesome-claude-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "safety",
    "supply-chain",
    "slopsquatting",
    "typosquatting",
    "npm",
    "pypi"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "minAgeDays": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Minimum age (days)",
      "description": "A package first published fewer days ago than this asks you first.",
      "default": 14,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 3650
    },
    "minWeeklyDownloads": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Minimum weekly downloads",
      "description": "A package with fewer weekly downloads than this asks you first (npm, PyPI, crates.io; RubyGems is estimated from lifetime downloads).",
      "default": 50,
      "min": 0
    },
    "allowList": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Always allowed",
      "description": "Comma-separated package names never checked, such as your private or internal packages.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "timeoutMs": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Registry timeout (ms)",
      "description": "How long to wait for a registry before letting the install run unchecked.",
      "default": 5000,
      "min": 500,
      "max": 9000
    }
  }
}
